about_short_description.short_description: Castia is a Latam-based proptech that enables Latam homeowners to relocate to a new property in a quick and easy manner.

product.name: Castia App
product.description: A digital platform that enables tenants to pay rent, accumulate points redeemable for home purchase down payments, and build credit history through monthly rent payments.

product.name: Rent Payment Management Service
product.description: A service that manages and processes rent payments from tenants to landlords through a centralized system, ensuring secure and timely fund transfers.

product.name: Castia Bricks Loyalty Program
product.description: A points-based loyalty program where tenants earn points for rent payments that can be redeemed for gift cards, promotional bonuses, or as funds toward a home down payment.

product.name: Rent Payment Credit Reporting Service
product.description: A service that reports tenants' rent payment history to credit bureaus to help build or improve their credit scores.

product.name: Rent-to-Own Advisory and Financing Service
product.description: A service that assists tenants in transitioning from renting to homeownership by providing advisory support and access to credit lines for home purchase.
